privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: {{appName}} is used solely to record attendance and feedback for the English Hub Rocketseat | LATAM English Conversation classes taught by Teacher Dan.
privacy.whatWeCollectBody: When you check in, we store your email address, country, optional role, how much you spoke, perceived conversation level, 1–5 class rating, and any optional comments or topic suggestions you write.
privacy.howWeUseItBody: Your data is used only to track class attendance and help the teacher improve future classes. We do not use analytics, advertising trackers, or third-party marketing tools.
privacy.localStorageBody: For convenience, your browser saves your email, country and role in localStorage so you don't have to retype them next class. You can clear this anytime using the "Not you?" link on step 1.
privacy.contactBody: Ask Teacher Dan during class or reach out via the Rocketseat / Digital House community channels to have your check-in data deleted.
